title: Keep commits tidy (commercial Mandate 94), in the active contract
goal: Vision: V-19. Directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep commits tidy. The rule lands in core's active contract beside the code rules: one whole labelled change per commit with trailers in the final paragraph; a subject of at most 72 characters that says what; a body saying why for a change over 100 lines; only source (no build output, scratch, blobs of 1 MiB or more, or secrets, which are rotated at once); published history never rewritten, a published mistake corrected by a new commit. Pinned in tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: core's distill lint (xtask/src/distill/lint.rs) checks Task trailers, records, scopes and host merges; the active contract already forbids rewriting shared history and empty or noise commits; the commercial workflow commits verb (susi-commercial-apps Mandate 94) reviews message shape and content. This adds one contract rule and one brief sentence; no new code.
